name: claude-mini-hud
description: Claude Code StatusLine plugin — context / token / todos / tools / agents + cost / Git / ETA / alerts + 21 progress bar themes + multi-provider usage

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && node --import tsx --test tests/stdin.test.ts tests/usage.test.ts
scripts.test:stdin: npm run build && node -e "process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({model:{display_name:'MiniMax-M3'},context_window:{current_usage:{input_tokens:45000},context_window_size:200000},transcript_path:'/tmp/test.jsonl'}))" | node dist/index.js
